question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India provides that the Governor appoints the Chief Minister and later, the Chief Minister recommends the appointment of ministers to the Governor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 164**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 164 of the Constitution of India** delineates the process of **appointing Chief Ministers and other ministers **within states.
 
• According to this article, the Governor is tasked with appointing the Chief Minister and other ministers based on the advice of the Chief Minister.
